_comment: Course definitions for the city×course engine. `label` is the course name in the H1/title; `build` are 'what you build' items; `applied` phrases how the course applies to a city's industries.

courses.label: Data Analytics with AI
build: a cleaned, modelled dataset from a real business scenario
a metrics analysis — funnel, cohort or operations — with a clear conclusion
an AI-assisted workflow that queries, cleans and visualises data
a published analytics case study you keep as portfolio
courses.applied: turn operational and business data into decisions
courses.distinct: reading messy data all the way to a business decision

courses.label: Power BI
build: a modelled dataset built with Power Query
a dashboard with DAX measures and time intelligence
interactive reports with slicers, drill-through and row-level security
a published Power BI dashboard you keep as portfolio
courses.applied: turn business data into dashboards leaders actually open
courses.distinct: the self-refreshing dashboard a leader opens every morning

courses.label: Generative AI
build: a document-grounded generative assistant over a real corpus
a brand-voice content generator producing on-identity variants
a retrieval-augmented tool that answers with cited sources
a published generative-AI project you keep as portfolio
courses.applied: build generative tools for content, documents and knowledge
courses.distinct: grounded generative tools that draft, summarise and cite real sources

courses.label: AI Automation
build: an AI agent that completes a multi-step task end to end
an automated workflow that removes a repetitive process
an agent connected to real data and tools
a published automation project you keep as portfolio
courses.applied: take repetitive operations off people's plates with agents and workflows
courses.distinct: lifting a repetitive, rules-shaped process off a team entirely

courses.label: AI Digital Marketing
build: an AI-assisted performance campaign for a real brand
a content-and-creative system producing on-brand variants at scale
a marketing analytics view tying spend to funnel and results
a published digital-marketing case study you keep as portfolio
courses.applied: run AI-accelerated campaigns tied to real results
courses.distinct: campaigns whose every rupee is tied back to funnel and CAC

courses.label: Prompt Engineering
build: a production-style prompt with structure, constraints and examples
a prompt test-and-evaluation set that measures quality
a prompt-versioned mini-tool for a real scenario
a published prompt-engineering project you keep as portfolio
courses.applied: design, test and harden prompts that hold up in production
courses.distinct: prompts built as tested, versioned, production artifacts

courses.label: Python for AI
build: working Python scripts that read, clean and transform data
a first AI/ML script using standard Python libraries
an AI-assisted workflow that writes and debugs Python with you
a published Python-for-AI project you keep as portfolio
courses.applied: learn the language under modern AI, from first steps to working scripts
courses.distinct: the programming language that sits under almost all modern AI

courses.label: SQL
build: real queries with joins, aggregations and window functions
a query-driven analysis of a real business dataset
an AI-assisted workflow that drafts and optimises SQL
a published SQL project you keep as portfolio
courses.applied: query and shape the data under every analytics and engineering job
courses.distinct: querying the database directly to pull the exact data you need

courses.label: Data Science
build: a framed, validated ML model with honest evaluation
a data product that turns a model into something usable
an experiment-and-metrics analysis with a defensible conclusion
a published data-science project you keep as portfolio
courses.applied: build and ship models and data products, not notebooks
courses.distinct: framing and validating a model that actually ships, not a notebook

courses.label: AI Agents
build: a tool-using agent that completes a multi-step task
an agent connected to real data and internal tools
an evaluated agent workflow with guardrails and failure handling
a published AI-agent project you keep as portfolio
courses.applied: build tool-using agents that reliably do real work
courses.distinct: tool-using agents that plan, call tools and act reliably

courses.label: AI App Development
build: an AI-powered app feature wired to a real model
a working app MVP taken from idea to deployment
an app that integrates AI with real data and user input
a published, deployed AI app you keep as portfolio
courses.applied: build and ship real AI-powered apps, not prototypes
courses.distinct: taking an AI app from idea to a deployed, usable product

courses.label: AI Content Creation
build: an AI-assisted content pipeline from idea to finished piece
a multi-format set — video, social, thumbnail — for one brand
a brand-voice content system producing on-identity variants
a published content-creation project you keep as portfolio
courses.applied: use AI across video, social and brand content with real craft
courses.distinct: directing AI across video, social and brand content with real craft
